players.product: 8-inch analog / power (BCD) specialty foundry; 650V GaN HEMT and 1,200V SiC MOSFET foundry processes in customer qualification

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 774,049,959,498 (H1 2025: KRW 634,787,093,359) and operating profit KRW 172,142,028,259 (H1 2025: KRW 126,343,860,643); Q2 2026 revenue KRW 414,450,390,729 (Q2 2025: KRW 337,406,491,433) and Q2 operating profit KRW 105,233,009,884 (Q2 2025: KRW 73,842,437,551). Semiconductor (wafer foundry) segment revenue KRW 756,330M (97.7%; H1 2025 KRW 626,815M) with segment operating profit KRW 172,125M (H1 2025 KRW 127,714M). The ferroalloy segment was suspended by board resolution on 2026-05-29 and reported as discontinued operations (H1 loss KRW 42,908M)
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue KRW 774,049,959,498; operating profit KRW 172,142,028,259; foundry segment revenue KRW 756,330M

quarterly_data.signal: Fab capacity 154,000 wafers per month (Bucheon Fab1 91,000; Sangwoo Fab2 63,000); H1 2026 shipments 839,875 wafers (Fab1 508,413; Fab2 331,462); average loading (utilisation) 94.94% (Fab1 95.61%, Fab2 94.10%)
quarterly_data.figure: utilisation 94.94%; capacity 154,000 wafers/month; H1 shipments 839,875 wafers

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor order-contract balance KRW 111,068M at June 30, 2026, up from KRW 84,799M at the start of the year (new contracts KRW 750,111M, revenue recognised KRW 723,842M in H1); no external customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue. Revenue by region in H1 2026: China KRW 504,871M, Korea KRW 95,462M, US KRW 68,453M, Taiwan KRW 44,779M, Japan KRW 18,562M, Netherlands KRW 12,597M; US end-customer foundry revenue (collected via DB HiTek USA) KRW 67,916M
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor contract backlog KRW 111,068M (start of 2026: KRW 84,799M)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex: 2026 investment plan KRW 4,177 hundred million for cleanroom expansion and capacity supplementation, KRW 1,762 hundred million executed in H1; further capacity investment expected but not yet fixed. Unexecuted PP&E / intangible purchase commitments KRW 149,615M (consolidated); H1 cash paid for PP&E KRW 101,008,527,197. Agreement with Eumseong County for Sangwoo (Fab2) capacity expansion and next-generation power-semiconductor investment (KRW 1,400M subsidy received)
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 capex plan KRW 4,177 hundred million (KRW 1,762 hundred million spent in H1); commitments KRW 149,615M

quarterly_data.signal: Next-generation products: the company is developing SiC, GaN and silicon-capacitor processes and says it will pursue mass-production investment on the premise of collaboration with overseas strategic customers and profitability. H1 R&D included SJ MOSFET Gen2 900V/950V (development complete; NDI and risk production of 26 products under way), SJ MOSFET Gen3 low-Ron (<50mohm, Infineon-compatible), a 2nd-generation 900V gate-driver IC process, IGBT 700V (front-end set-up and customer-product reliability verified), 0.18um 120V BCD at Fab2, RF SOI Gen4 and RF HRS Gen4 for mobile, SPAD pixels for automotive LiDAR and global-shutter pixels; R&D spend KRW 60,061M (7.76% of revenue)

Suppliers and licensors (parent): process wafers KRW 50,525M (45.48% of H1 purchases) from Siltron and Shin-Etsu among others; chemicals KRW 23,129M from Dongwoo Fine-Chem among others; gases KRW 7,967M from SK Specialty among others; targets KRW 1,702M from KFMI; photomasks KRW 24,548M from DNP and TPK among others; line consumables from DuPont. Average process-wafer price USD 36.56 (FY2025: USD 39.23). Technology licences with Texas Instruments (royalties) and with eMemory, Cadence and Synopsys (fees on licensed products). Subsidiary DB GlobalChip (display driver ICs) buys wafers from DB HiTek (KRW 59,836M) and film from LG Innotek (KRW 9,202M)
quarterly_data.counterparty: SK Siltron, Shin-Etsu Chemical, Dongwoo Fine-Chem, SK Specialty, KFMI, Dai Nippon Printing, DuPont, Texas Instruments, eMemory, Cadence, Synopsys

quarterly_data.signal: Foundry market share (company table citing OMDIA and Refinitiv): DB HiTek 0.5% in 2026F (0.6% in 2025), VIS 1.0%, Tower 1.1%, X-Fab 0.5%. The company says it is expanding orders from large customers in China, the US, Europe and Japan, centred on BCDMOS analog / power and high-voltage products with premium pricing
